DOP: āracayāracayā f. [ from imperat. of *ā 2 + racati? cf S. ā√rac and AiG II.1 § 124b ], arranging again and again; pulling this way and that ; Sn 673 (jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ~ā vihananti, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce ārajayārajayā; Pj II 482, 2 : ārajayārajayā vihanantī ti … ~ā ti pi pāṭho, āviñjitvā āviñjitvā ti attho).
CPD: āracayâracayā [ā + √rac, but in another meaning + ya], v. r. (pi-pāṭha) recorded by Buddha- ghosa for the next, in the meaning of 'āviñjitvā āviñ- jitvā' i. e. 'having pulled repeatedly'; jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ~ vihananti, Sn 673 (Pj ll 482, 2-3 ). Rem. This difficult reading could be peṃ. also a double form of āra-cayā ( from 1 āra + √ci, caya heap, collection, multitude ), in the emphatic sense of 'with many weapons'.
